definitions.explanation: The act of making something less severe, strict, or intense. Used for easing pain, relaxing regulations, reducing tensions, or moderating conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{緩和|かんわ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I took medicine to alleviate the pain.

examples.japanese: {規制|きせい}{緩和|かんわ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: New businesses emerged thanks to deregulation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{首脳会談|しゅのうかいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧⟦{徐々|じょじょ}→徐々：03082_jojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{緩和|かんわ}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧つつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Tensions between the two countries are gradually easing following the summit meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
A versatile word used across many domains. In medicine, it means pain relief or palliative care ({緩和|かんわ}ケア). In economics and politics, {規制|きせい}{緩和|かんわ} (deregulation) and ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧{緩和|かんわ} (monetary easing) are key terms. In diplomacy, it describes easing of tensions.

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{漢和|かんわ}→漢和：04019_kanwa⟧ (Chinese-Japanese, as in ⟦{漢和|かんわ}→漢和：04019_kanwa⟧⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧, a kanji dictionary).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {規制|きせい}{緩和|かんわ}: deregulation, relaxation of regulations
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧{緩和|かんわ}: monetary easing
- ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧{緩和|かんわ}: easing of tensions, détente
- {緩和|かんわ}ケア: palliative care
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{緩和|かんわ}: pain relief
